title: BcpBlockV1
description: One ACP compression block as persisted in a <session>.acp.json sidecar (an element of its top-level "blocks" array). Only the listed properties are part of the v1 stability contract: evolution is additive-only (new optional fields may appear), and renaming/removing/re-semanticking a listed field requires bumping the sidecar's schemaVersion. additionalProperties are permitted because real blocks carry extra internal pruning/index fields that are intentionally outside the contract.

blockId.description: Idempotency key. Stable across restarts; never reused.

compressedTokens.description: Tokens of original content compressed by this block.

createdAt.description: Creation time, epoch MILLISECONDS (not an ISO string).

topic.description: Short human label for the compressed range.

startRef.description: Model-facing start ref, e.g. m00005. Absent when unknown.

endRef.description: Model-facing end ref, e.g. m00020. Absent when unknown.

effectiveMessageIds.description: Raw message ids covered by this block (authoritative coverage set).
